provenance.note: Explicit AOI (min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat) EPSG:4326 - the harbour approach the domain is cut from the shoreline inside [supplied on this invocation]
Incident monochromatic wave period - a PRESCRIBED demo forcing, since no wave-forcing fetcher exists yet [supplied on this invocation]
Incident wave height H0 on the designated liquid boundary; Kd is measured against it, so it sets the scale of every narrated height [supplied on this invocation]
Incident wave direction in the TRIG convention (0 = +X east, 90 = +Y north) - not the compass bearing [supplied on this invocation]
The declared structure's reflection coefficient: 1 fully reflecting (a vertical quay), 0 fully absorbing (a rubble slope). Every other solid face is the absorbing shore [supplied on this invocation]

Finest triangle edge, used at the shoreline and around the structure. THE granularity lever: a phase-resolving solve needs several nodes per WAVELENGTH and Kd peaks inside a diffraction fringe, so a coarse mesh reads the peaks low [supplied on this invocation]
Solve sizing class [supplied on this invocation]
Mesh gradation: how fast the edge may grow from the structure band out to the open approach [declared constant default]
The width the mapped structure centreline is cut at; a survey maps a mound as a line and a line removes no water from the domain [declared scenario default]

The whole length of the transect the agitation is read along: a straight line through the structure's centroid along the incident wave direction, half of it on the exposed side and half in the lee [declared scenario default]
How deep a boundary stretch must reach for it to be designated the OPEN edge the incident wave enters through; every stretch that reaches it opens [declared scenario default]
